entities.name: Níkos Nikolópoulos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikolaos Nikolopoulos is a Greek politician. He has served as Member of the Greek Parliament from 2009 to 2019 and previously from 1989 to 2007. He formerly sat as an Independent, after leaving the Independent Greeks.
